description: A shell script for testing the functionality of 'git check-ignore', including various test cases for ignore rules, submodules, symlinks, global ignores, stdin handling, and edge cases.

methods.name: init_vars
methods.description: Initializes variables related to excludes file configuration.

methods.name: enable_global_excludes
methods.description: Enables global excludes by configuring core.excludesfile.

methods.name: expect_in
methods.description: Checks that the specified output (stdout or stderr) contains expected content.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Verifies that stdout contains the expected output.

methods.name: expect_from_stdin
methods.description: Writes specified input to stdout for comparison with test results.

methods.name: test_stderr
methods.description: Verifies that stderr contains expected content.

methods.name: stderr_contains
methods.description: Checks if stderr output contains a given regex pattern.

methods.name: stderr_empty_on_success
methods.description: Verifies that stderr is empty on successful tests, or matches expected failure conditions.

methods.name: test_check_ignore
methods.description: Executes 'git check-ignore' with provided arguments and verifies the output and exit code.

methods.name: test_expect_success_multiple
methods.description: Runs multiple related tests with different verbosity and index options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up the test environment and executes a test sequence.
